# Crypto backend licenses

The backend comes from the official Mbed TLS 4.1.1 source release, including
TF-PSA-Crypto 1.1.1. The build verifies the archive SHA-256. This project elects
the Apache-2.0 option offered by those distributions; the upstream full license
notices are retained here and shipped with the module. Backend source headers
retain the upstream copyright and SPDX notices.

Upstream: https://github.com/Mbed-TLS/mbedtls/releases/tag/mbedtls-4.1.1
